title: RumVitalWebsocketClosedEvent
description: Schema for the vital reported when a WebSocket connection stops being tracked, whether because it closed or because tracking ended first. Reported at most once per connection

name.description: Name of the vital, identifying the phase of the connection it reports

closed_date.description: Date tracking of the connection ended, in ms from epoch. It is the date the connection closed when the tracking end reason is close_event, and the date tracking stopped otherwise

duration.description: Interval between the connecting date and the closed date of the connection, in nanoseconds. It is not vital.duration, which is reported by duration vitals

tracking_end_reason.description: Why tracking of the connection ended

close_code.description: Code the connection was closed with. Reported when, and only when, the tracking end reason is close_event

close_reason.description: Reason the connection was closed with, as an empty string when the other side supplied none. Reported when, and only when, the tracking end reason is close_event

was_clean.description: Whether the connection closed cleanly. Reported when, and only when, the tracking end reason is close_event

snapshot_version.description: Version of the snapshot, incremented on every vital reporting one, so that heartbeats can be ordered when they are received out of sequence

snapshot.description: Values of the connection when tracking ended. Omitted when the connection never opened
